# AOSP camera metadata (third party)

`camera_metadata.c`, `camera_metadata_tag_info.c` and their headers from AOSP `platform/system/media`
(`camera/src`, `camera/include/system`, `private/camera/include`), tag `android-15.0.0_r1`, commit
0287f16fc74c607c04a9570ee3ae914e1285cd2c, unmodified. Apache License 2.0 (NOTICE). The C library behind
`android.hardware.camera2.impl.CameraMetadataNative` (framework/javacore-shim/camerametadata_natives.c).

`compat/log/log.h` is Westlake's: AOSP's logging macros to stderr.
